translations.rule: EMV magnitude maps to evidence_strength input for arifOS judge. EMV > USD 50M → HIGH evidence strength. EMV USD 10-50M → MEDIUM. EMV < USD 10M → LOW.
translations.default_assumption: EMV computed from scenarios with typed inputs and explicit assumptions
translations.if_wrong_cost: arifOS judge weights the wrong evidence strength → incorrect verdict bias.

translations.rule: If allocation involves irreversible commitment (drilling, land purchase, capital lock), WEALTH must set reversibility_level = NONE. arifOS judge then routes to TIER_3 gate.
translations.default_assumption: Reversible = capital can be reallocated within 90 days without significant loss
translations.if_wrong_cost: WEALTH claims REVERSIBLE when actual is IRREVERSIBLE → arifOS judge applies wrong gate → Arif commits without proper hold.

translations.rule: LOCAL = one project. ORGAN = WEALTH organ only. FEDERATION = affects ≥2 organs. IRREVERSIBLE_GLOBAL = cannot undo at all. Map WEALTH blast_radius to arifOS scale.
translations.default_assumption: Single-well appraisal = LOCAL. Field development = ORGAN. PSC commitment = FEDERATION.
translations.if_wrong_cost: Wrong blast_radius → wrong arifOS judge routing → verdict from wrong gate.

translations.rule: WEALTH risk verdict LOW → epistemic_state = OBS/DER. MEDIUM → DER. HIGH → INT flagged. CRITICAL → SPEC flagged. arifOS judge applies epistemic floor.
translations.default_assumption: HIGH risk verdict requires explicit INT/Spec acknowledgment in envelope
translations.if_wrong_cost: WEALTH claims DER when evidence is actually SPEC → arifOS judge applies wrong epistemic floor → Arif acts on false confidence.

translations.rule: If WEALTH flags 888_HOLD required, arifOS judge MUST halt the verdict loop and return hold trigger. WEALTH does not bypass this.
translations.default_assumption: 888_HOLD never bypassed — WEALTH prepares envelope, Arif holds veto
translations.if_wrong_cost: 888_HOLD bypassed → irreversible action taken without Arif's veto → F13 SOVEREIGN breach.

note: WEALTH prepares the arifOS judge envelope. WEALTH never submits without explicit authority. arifOS renders the verdict. Arif holds the veto.
